resources.string: ASCILI needs camera access to render live ASCII video streams. All processing is 100% on-device.
ASCILI needs microphone access to record audio along with your ASCII video.
Permission denied. You can enable it anytime in Android Settings.

ASCILI respects your privacy:

1. 100% On-Device Processing: All real-time ASCII conversion, webcam rendering, and video encoding occur strictly on your device.
2. Zero Cloud Transmission: No camera frames, audio recordings, or personal data are ever uploaded to any server.
3. Completely Offline: The core ASCII video engine functions 100% offline without requiring internet connectivity.
4. Local Storage: Exported videos, GIFs, and subtitles are saved only to your local storage or shared at your explicit request.
